verdict.rationale: Retell ships a built-in Analytics dashboard that charts call and chat data, including success rate, latency, cost and concurrency, with filters and breakdowns. It also has built-in call success and sentiment scoring and AI QA sentiment trends, so a founder does not need to build their own dashboards. However, call durations are never explicitly shown as a dashboard metric, and outcome and sentiment reporting is only implied rather than documented as a dashboard chart. missing for 10: explicit call-duration metrics in dashboards, documented outcome and sentiment charts within the analytics dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own

citations.quote: Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency, with charts, filters, and breakdowns.
The Analytics dashboard charts your call and chat data so you can see how your agents are performing over time.
Built-in call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to your CRM.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
